nodes.description: Owner contract state variable holding the current owner address (payable).
Owner contract state variable holding the pending owner address awaiting acceptOwnership.
Mapping(address => uint256) of admin authorizations used by the onlyAdmin modifier.
ProxyStorage state variable holding the logic (implementation) contract address used as delegatecall target.
Owner constructor; sets owner = msg.sender and admins[owner] = 1.
external onlyOwner; stores _nextOwner into pendingOwner.
external; requires msg.sender == pendingOwner and then sets owner = msg.sender.
external onlyOwner; directly overwrites owner with _nextOwner.
external onlyOwner; sets admins[_admin] = auth.
Modifier requiring payable(msg.sender) == owner; guards privileged functions.
Modifier requiring sender == owner or admins[sender] != 0.
ProxyEntry constructor; invokes _setProxyLogic(logicAddr) to initialize the implementation.
external onlyOwner; updates the delegatecall target via _setProxyLogic.
internal; writes logicAddr into the _implement state variable.
payable fallback; forwards all calldata via delegatecall to _implement using inline assembly.
payable receive function; accepts plain Ether transfers, empty body.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership init, access control checks and acceptOwnership.
Unsafe inline-assembly delegatecall in fallback executing arbitrary logic contract code in proxy storage context.
Parameter _nextOwner of Owner.transferOwnership.
Parameter _nextOwner of Owner.setOwner.
Parameter _admin of Owner.setAdmin.
Parameter auth of Owner.setAdmin.
Parameter logicAddr of ProxyEntry.constructor.
Parameter logicAddr of ProxyEntry.setProxyLogic.
Local variable sender = payable(msg.sender) in Owner.acceptOwnership.
Local variable sender = payable(msg.sender) in onlyAdmin modifier.
Local variable addr = _implement in ProxyEntry.fallback used as delegatecall target.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the Owner constructor to initialize owner and the admins mapping.
onlyOwner compares payable(msg.sender) against the owner state variable for authorization.
onlyAdmin maps msg.sender to an authorization entry in admins.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal pendingOwner before ownership transfer.
onlyOwner modifier guards execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards execution of setOwner.
onlyOwner modifier guards execution of setAdmin.
onlyOwner modifier guards execution of setProxyLogic.
Constructor assigns owner = payable(msg.sender).
Constructor writes admins[owner] = 1 granting full admin authority.
Parameter _nextOwner flows into the pendingOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the state variable pendingOwner.
Parameter _nextOwner is written directly into the owner state variable.
setOwner writes the owner state variable, bypassing the pendingOwner handshake.
Parameter _admin is used as the key written into the admins mapping.
Parameter auth is stored as the authority value of admins[_admin].
setAdmin writes into the admins state mapping.
acceptOwnership reads pendingOwner to validate the caller before transferring ownership.
Local sender in acceptOwnership is assigned from payable(msg.sender).
acceptOwnership assigns the caller-derived local sender to the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership performs the ownership write to the owner state variable.
Local sender in onlyAdmin is assigned from payable(msg.sender).
onlyAdmin modifier initializes and uses its local sender variable.
ProxyEntry constructor calls the internal _setProxyLogic function.
Constructor parameter logicAddr flows into _setProxyLogic as the implementation address.
setProxyLogic delegates the write to the internal _setProxyLogic function.
setProxyLogic parameter logicAddr flows into _setProxyLogic as the implementation address.
_setProxyLogic writes the _implement state variable that controls the delegatecall target.
fallback reads the _implement state variable into local addr.
The local addr derived from _implement is used as the delegatecall target address.
The delegatecall target is ultimately controlled by the _implement state variable set through setProxyLogic.
The fallback function executes the assembly delegatecall forwarding calldata to the logic contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter is only meaningful as the input written into pendingOwner inside transferOwnership, so it is subsumed by that function node.
The parameter is only used as the value assigned to owner inside setOwner, so it is subsumed by that function node.
The parameter serves only as the mapping key written by setAdmin, so it is subsumed by that function node.
The parameter serves only as the authorization value written by setAdmin, so it is subsumed by that function node.
The parameter is consumed only by the constructor forwarding it to _setProxyLogic, so it is subsumed by the constructor node.
The parameter is consumed only by setProxyLogic forwarding it to _setProxyLogic, so it is subsumed by that function node.
The local sender is a transient alias of msg.sender inside acceptOwnership carrying the ownership write, so it merges into the function node.
The local sender is a transient alias of msg.sender used only by the onlyAdmin authorization check, so it merges into that modifier node.
The local addr is a transient alias of _implement used solely as the delegatecall target, so it merges into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
